validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="a" datamodel="ecmascript">
  <datamodel><data id="arr" expr="[1,2]"/></datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <onentry><foreach array="arr" item="1bad" index="i"><log expr="i"/></foreach></onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<foreach item>` must be a variable name, but `1bad` starts with a digit
notes: `<foreach>` assigns each array element (`item`) and its position (`index`) to a variable with this name, creating it when it is not declared; the name must be a legal identifier of the `ecmascript` data model
diagnostics.help: use a name that starts with a letter or `$` and contains only ASCII letters, digits, `_`, and `$` (the ECMAScript data model reserves names that start with `_` for system variables)
